description: This file defines the UserGroup class for managing user groups in an OpenCart admin system, including CRUD operations and permission management.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: Class for managing user groups, including CRUD operations and permission handling within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Creates a new user group record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing user group record identified by user_group_id.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Deletes a user group record from the database by user_group_id.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a user group record by user_group_id, decoding permissions JSON.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of user groups with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of user group records.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission route to a user group's permissions.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission route from a user group's permissions.
